authority: Phase 0B forward snapshot contract (phase0b_forward_snapshot_contract.json, version nhl-forward-snapshot-contract-2) is authoritative; this file registers capture timing and the recommendation rule.

recommendation_rule.candidate_universe_roster_horizon: play-by-play rosterSpots qualifies if required-source success rate >= 0.99, final dressed SKATER recall >= 0.995 and final SOG coverage from the roster candidate set >= 0.995
recommendation_rule.goalie_starter_confirmation: not part of this pass; never claimed
recommendation_rule.minimum_sample: at least 50 completed games with postgame truth on at least 3 distinct game dates AND at least 40 COMPLETE_VALID observations at the horizon
recommendation_rule.several_qualify: recommend the earliest / farthest-from-puck-drop qualifying horizon

required_source_success_rate: COMPLETE_VALID game-horizons / attempted game-horizons (attempted = captures with at least one endpoint observation)
scope: hockey information collection only; no prediction, no model, no sportsbook data

timing_rules.decision_key: game_id|horizon|scheduled_start_utc (a revised start creates a new key; old evidence immutable)
timing_rules.game_status: COMPLETE_VALID only if every required endpoint observation is VALID_HORIZON; otherwise the worst exact status (REFUSED > MISSED_HORIZON_CUTOFF > PROVIDER_FAILURE > REJECTED_NOT_PREGAME_STATE > EARLY_NOT_HORIZON_EVIDENCE)
timing_rules.puck_drop: REFUSED when initiated at/after the scheduled start
timing_rules.qualifies: every endpoint request starts before the cutoff and completes in [cutoff - 180 s, cutoff]
timing_rules.same_cutoff_groups: keys with cutoffs within 60 s are captured together with <= 8 concurrent games
timing_rules.wake: the job may wake up to 20 minutes before a cutoff and waits inside the same job
